answer: In this PoA model, EigenTrust derives centrality from weighted feedback, while reciprocity-weighted transitivity discounts isolated or one-way endorsements. Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so an identity must provide sustained honest service to retain influence. Freshly spawned sybils begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality and lack trusted paths through the trellis; like a river without tributaries or a beacon without observers, they cannot accumulate enough credible support to pass consensus.
